name: The Travelers Adventure
source:
Dive into a Life Of Adventure Gathering Dabloons and Other Things!

The day is starting and you find yourself in a mysterious inn...

You can see many different beings sitting at different tables that are lit by candles...

In one portion of the room you spot an empty table and choose to go there.

As you sit down to begin your night after a long day of traveling you hear little pitter patter behind you...

"Hello There Dear Traveler, What Brings You To This Part of Town?"

The Travelers Adventure is fun little visual novel where you, the player, meet many different characters and try to collect as many dabloons as possible with the choices you make!

What will you do in the game? What choices will you make? I wonder Traveler do you think you will be rich off Dabloons maybe or one of the most broke ones?!

[From [url=https://crimsayoyoko.itch.io/thetravelersadventure]Itch.io[/url]]
